text: Yes, the forest on this property was cleared. Earth observation data confirms tree-cover loss of approximately 0.7 hectares within the 58.1-hectare rural property in 2023. The change was detected by multiple independent sources, including the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference map. The affected area was identified as planted forest (Eucalyptus species), not native forest. While the evidence confirms the clearing occurred, it does not specify whether the activity was legal, authorized, or the responsible party.
